title: Add DuckDB as analytics query layer over JSON files
description: Replace manual JSON file traversal in reports with DuckDB queries. DuckDB reads JSON files directly (read_json), enabling fast analytical queries (GROUP BY, SUM, AVG) without importing data. JSON files remain the source of truth for CRUD; DuckDB is the read-only analytics layer.
acceptance_criteria: tools/db/query.py — DuckDB wrapper that reads entity JSON files directly via read_json
tools/db/views.sql — Predefined SQL views for common agent queries (delivery_stats, driver_performance, cost_analysis, trends)
Existing reports refactored to use DuckDB instead of manual file traversal
No data duplication — JSON files remain single source of truth
Zero infrastructure — DuckDB runs embedded (in-process or single file)
